title: graphics.ilbm.decode result
description: What the form is, not what it holds. The indices are `graphics.bitmap.export`'s to write, and sending a megapixel buffer back through a response envelope would make the cheap question as expensive as the export. HAM, HAM8 and Extra-Halfbrite are refused by name rather than described as flat indices.

indexable_colours.description: Palette indices the plane count can express, `1 << planes`.

transparent_colour.description: The transparent index, meaningful only for `transparent_colour` masking.

has_mask.description: Whether the form interleaves a mask plane, which the decode consumes either way rather than letting it shift the data planes.

viewport_mode.description: The raw CAMG viewport mode word, when the form carries one. Absent rather than zero: no CAMG and a CAMG of zero are different claims.

aspect.description: Pixel aspect, as BMHD states it.

palette.description: CMAP entries as RGB8, in order. Empty when the form carries none — never filled with invented colours.
